turns.prompt_text: how do you make chicken tikka masala
turns.response_html: To make chicken tikka masala, marinate cubed chicken in a mixture of yogurt and spices like garam masala, turmeric, and cumin. Sear the marinated chicken until browned, then set it aside. In the same pan, create the sauce by sautéing onions, garlic, ginger, and additional spices, then add tomato sauce and heavy cream. Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer until cooked through. Serve it with rice or naan.
